project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-152 mem0 & Internal-Services Decoupling (Open Core)
description:
PRD-152 makes long-term memory (mem0) and every cloud-internal service URL local-safe by default. SCOPE = config truthfulness + consumer guards + tests + one architecture doc, on the orchestrator/services side ONLY. The mem0 integration itself is HEALTHY and must not be refactored: orchestrator/modules/memory/integrations/mem0_client.py speaks the standard OpenMemory REST API over httpx with per-workspace circuit breaker + 30s health probe (orchestrator/services/heartbeat_service.py:181-217) — do not touch its request/breaker logic. The work: (1) flip the nine *.railway.internal defaults in orchestrator/config.py (verified lines 367, 368, 438, 439, 451, 469, 646, 669, 788) to local-compose DNS (MEM0_API_URL=http://mem0-server:8765) or empty-and-feature-off, keeping the os.getenv(name, default) env-override form so Railway env vars still win; (2) flip LOG_RELAY_ENABLED default to false (config.py ~line 452) and in the 3 standalone copies services/{shared,workspace-worker,agent-opt-worker}/automatos_logging.py; (3) remove the two hardcoded railway fallbacks in orchestrator/modules/tools/discovery/handlers_monitoring.py:153,207 and the example-host strings in orchestrator/modules/tools/registry/tool_registry.py:1101-1102; (4) every consumer no-ops cleanly on empty URL with one boot log line naming the enabling var (voice, opt-worker, log-relay, loki/prom); (5) pin the degraded lane (mem0 unreachable under new defaults) in the existing mem0 test trio; (6) document the mem0 internal-service contract + fork-vs-upstream delta in docs/architecture/. The committed env contract already exists and is ground truth for target values: envs/api.defaults (MEM0_API_URL=http://mem0-server:8765, LOG_RELAY_ENABLED=false, empty LOKI/PROM/OPT/VOICE URLs) and envs/observability.defaults. STACKING: branch cuts from ralph/prd-151-storage-minio tip; PRD-150 (auth pluggable) and PRD-151 (storage pluggable, MinIO) are DONE underneath you. PRD-153 runs NEXT in the chain and owns: all docker-compose edits/folds/deletions (US-003/US-006 compose halves of the PRD), the CI compose-boot smoke (US-007 lane A / L3 round-trip), .env.example, and QUICKSTART. Therefore OUT OF SCOPE tonight: editing or deleting ANY docker-compose*.yml (root or infrastructure/), editing .env/.env.example (block-secrets hook refuses anyway), publishing the mem0 image, touching the sibling ../automatos-mem0 repo (read-only reference), any MemoryProvider interface (explicit PRD non-goal), unified_memory_service/L-stack contract changes, frontend changes (frontend talks memory only via orchestrator API — verified frontend/hooks/use-memory-explorer-api.ts uses apiClient). METHOD per CLAUDE.md: TDD (update/extend orchestrator/tests/test_config_env_centralization.py — its _reload_config + _SWEPT_ENV_VARS harness is the reuse point — in the SAME commit as each default flip), no os.getenv outside config.py (the services/*/automatos_logging.py standalone copies are the only allowed exception — they have no config.py), no new files unless nothing fits, delete superseded values in the same story, canonical terms (Playbook/Mission/Task/Auto). Tests run from orchestrator/ with `python -m pytest tests/<file> -q --timeout=60` (pytest.ini pins pythonpath=., testpaths=tests; baselines verified green: config suite 54 passed, mem0 trio 28 passed, no DB needed). Commit only behind a green targeted suite; the branch tip must stay stackable for PRD-153 after every commit.

VERIFIER AMENDMENTS (BINDING — adversarial re-verification 2026-06-09; these OVERRIDE story text where they conflict):
1. Compose freeze is checked against the BRANCH BASE: git diff --quiet $(git merge-base HEAD ralph/prd-151-storage-minio)...HEAD -- docker-compose.yml infrastructure/ AND working-tree clean. A compose edit committed mid-run still fails the gate. Zero compose edits, period (PRD-153 owns compose).
2. S5 AC2 executes as exactly: for f in services/*/automatos_logging.py; do ! grep -n 'railway.internal' "$f" | grep -q . || exit 1; done
3. S6 citation fix: the OPENAI_API_KEY 'required — used by mem0 + opt worker' comment lives at infrastructure/.env.example:68 (root .env.example:43 has different text) — cite the right file in the doc.
4. S8's sweep additionally owns: orchestrator/scripts/probe_mem0_endpoints.py:5 (hardcoded PRODUCTION up.railway.app default + os.getenv outside config.py — route through config with default '', keep env override) and orchestrator/modules/tools/discovery/handlers_monitoring.py:~166-168 stale 'Railway internal network' error TEXT (modernize the message; configured-mode behavior stays byte-equivalent).
5. Counting ACs execute wrapped: test "$(grep -c 'railway.internal' orchestrator/config.py)" -eq 7 (and analogously for the other counts).
6. S7's default-config test must monkeypatch the _config attribute (existing trio pattern) — never rely on ambient MEM0_API_URL env (developer/CI env would bleed in at import).
7. UNIVERSAL: git diff HEAD~1 ACs are commit discipline; config.py/test line numbers WILL have drifted after PRD-150/151 land tonight — re-locate by content; all pytest invocations use python3 -m pytest.
